what: Travelers is a large American property and casualty insurer. It covers businesses against property damage, liability and workers' compensation, and households for homes and cars.
customers: Businesses of all sizes through independent agents and brokers, plus individual homeowners and drivers.
money: commercial property, liability and workers' compensation
home and car insurance for households
moat: More than 170 years of claims data, deep relationships with independent agents, and the scale to absorb large catastrophe losses.
risks: Hurricanes, wildfires and storms can produce very large losses in a single quarter
Reserves set aside for liability claims can prove insufficient as court awards rise
Commercial insurance pricing softens when competitors chase growth
Investment income depends on interest rates
opportunities: Years of commercial rate increases are still earning through into results
Investment income has risen with higher bond yields on its large portfolio
It has returned capital steadily through dividends and buybacks
watch: The combined ratio excluding catastrophes, and reserve development each quarter.
